question: I'm an IS senior (P-020) with an ISP concentration and a History minor. Can courses like 79-104 (Global Histories) satisfy both IS general education requirements and History minor requirements?

domain_contributions.programs: IS degree: 79-104 may satisfy a humanities/gen-ed slot in the IS curriculum. History minor: 79-104 (Global Histories) is a standard History course and likely satisfies History minor requirements
domain_contributions.courses: 79-104 (Global Histories) — humanities course in the History department; broadly applicable to gen-ed requirements

key_facts: 79-104 is a History department course (79-xxx prefix) with humanities content
IS degree requires humanities/social science general education courses — 79-104 is a typical IS gen-ed course
